customer_name: Undisclosed global asset and wealth management firm
business_problem: A global asset and wealth manager needed to trace data through decades of systems and code to meet strict regulatory timelines. Manual lineage analysis and spreadsheet documentation could take more than six months, delaying decisions and audit responses.
solution_summary: Capgemini and the firm built an AI platform on AWS to extract data lineage from PySpark code and related enterprise context. GPT models and retrieval-augmented generation analyze source code enriched with metadata, business rules, and system dependencies, producing lineage, documentation, and governance insights. The team expanded the platform to automate business-rule and documentation extraction, generate entity-relationship diagrams, and visualize data flows across applications and additional codebases. The AWS cloud foundation also hosts the firm's data lake. Users can point the solution at a codebase, receive lineage results, and have a data steward review and validate them the next day, replacing a manual process that previously ran for months. The source does not name a specific AWS service or GPT model.

solution_components.role: Analyze code and contextual information to extract lineage, documentation, and governance insights.

data_flow: The platform combines PySpark code with metadata, business rules, and system dependencies; GPT and RAG generate lineage and documentation, which is visualized for review and validation by a data steward.
business_outcome: Governance and documentation effort fell by 50–70%, workflows accelerated by 30–50%, and lineage approval cycles that once took six months or more are now completed in days. Around $20 million in savings is projected over three years.
